verify.name: content-parses
verify.why: Every blog post body must parse into TinaCMS's rich-text AST. One unsupported construct fails the WHOLE document to a single invalid_markdown node and the post renders as raw text in a <pre>. Known breakers: a fenced code block indented inside a list item; a list nested inside another list item or a blockquote.

verify.name: tina-indexes-posts
verify.why: `tinacms audit` prints '✅ Audit passed' and exits 0 on an EMPTY collection, so the count must be asserted explicitly. A wrong collection path/format/glob would otherwise build all 59 pages with no posts, exit 0, and deploy. NOTE: this script uses `grep | head -1` and therefore asserts only the FIRST collection's count — it must be generalised per-collection before the `settings` and `page` collections land.

verify.name: build-and-routes
verify.command: bun run build:local && find dist -name '*.html' | sed 's|^dist||' | sort | diff .baseline/routes.txt -
verify.expect: only difference is an added /admin/index.html (the TinaCMS admin SPA); all 59 site routes present
verify.why: `bun run build` alone fails — it needs a running Tina GraphQL server. Use build:local. Tina's datalayer binds port 9000 and its client hardcodes localhost:4001, so another project holding either port breaks the build; pass --datalayer-port to work around it. `.baseline/routes.txt` is git-ignored and regenerated by Task 0.1.

verify.name: prose
verify.expect: 0 errors — and check the trailing 'in N files' count is 17, not 0
verify.why: Vale reports success on an empty file set. The .vale.ini glob is extension-scoped, so renaming posts silently pointed it at zero files once already.

verify.name: lint
verify.expect: fails ONLY on DESIGN.json, src/components/Header.astro, src/utils/og-templates/post.js, src/utils/og-templates/site.js — all pre-existing on main
verify.why: Not a clean gate. Any file outside that list appearing is a regression introduced by this branch.
